L46: Oncologists at the MSU Veterinary Medical Center conduct clinical research in order to find safer or more effective methods to screen for, prevent, diagnose, or treat cancers. Some findings may even have implications for human medicine.
L47: Clinical trials often require patients to meet certain requirements in order for the trial to effectively pinpoint its research investigations. Some trials offer subsidies or funding for care, and each is carefully designed and reviewed for safety. Please ask your veterinarian to contact MSU for further information about any of the studies listed here.

L74:   * ### 【27†Evaluating Benefit of a Novel Intra-articular Device in Dogs With a Suspected Hip Osteoarthritis】
L75: 
L76: Open
L77: This pilot study seeks to evaluate whether this benefit is seen in a larger cohort of dogs with suspected hip OA through the injection of this product in the affected hip joint.
L78: 
L79: 【27†Study Details】
L80:   * ### 【28†Treatment for Feline Atopic Skin Syndrome (FASS)】
L81: 
L82: Open
L83: 
L84: This clinical trial aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of an investigational veterinary drug delivered by skin injection for itching and inflammation associated with atopic skin syndrome in cats.
L85: 【28†Study Details】
L86:   * ### 【29†Intra-articular Injection for the Treatment of Canine Elbow Dysplasia】
L87: 
L88: Open
L89: 
L90: A new veterinary device composed of collagen and elastin particles has been developed; it has been shown to help protect cartilage from mechanical grinding. Previous anecdotal use of this product has been beneficial in dogs with elbow dysplasia.
L91: 
L92: 【29†Study Details】
L93:   * ### 【30†Immunotherapy for Urothelial Carcinoma in Dogs】
L94: 
L95: Open
L96: Development of a safe and beneficial immunotherapy option for canine urothelial carcinoma patients will advance veterinarians' ability to treat this disease and will provide an important model to inform future canine and human clinical trials in this area.
L97: 
L98: 【30†Study Details】
L99:   * ### 【31†Probiotic Study in Dogs】
L100: 
L101: Open
L102: 
L103: We are studying a novel live probiotic product typically found in the gut of healthy dogs to evaluate the ability of this probiotic to resolve diarrhea in dogs.
L104: 【31†Study Details】
L105:   * ### 【32†Lung Tumor Fluid Dynamics Study】
L106: 
L107: Open
L108: 
L109: Current chemotherapy treatments involve a direct injection into the tumor. We would like to use surgically removed lung tissue to better understand how drugs behave when they are injected into lung tumors in dogs, as well as humans, with lung tumors.
L110: 
L111: 【32†Study Details】
L112:   * ### 【33†Methylnaltrexone (MNTX) Clinical Study】
L113: 
L114: Open
L115: This study seeks to define the rate at which methylnaltrexone (MNTX) is metabolized in dogs following intravenous administration. Postoperative regurgitation is a common side effect of general anesthesia. The opioid-inhibiting effects of MNTX block the risk of opioid-related complications, without reducing pain control and pain management.
L116: 
L117: 【33†Study Details】
L118:   * ### 【34†Necrotizing Meningoencephalitis Study for Pugs (SEEP/STEEP)】
L119: 
L120: Open
L121: Necrotizing Meningoencephalitis in Pugs (PDE) is a devastating disease. Clinical signs include seizures, circling, cognitive changes, and visual deficits. Our goal is to identify neurological abnormalities in Pugs with high genomic risk for PDE before the onset of the above-mentioned advanced clinical signs.
L122: 
L123: 【34†Study Details】
L124:   * ### 【35†Evaluation of Liver Protectants for Xylitol Toxicity in Dogs】
L125: 
L126: Open
L127: Xylitol is an artificial sweetener commonly found in sugar-free gum. Although safe for humans, xylitol is highly toxic to dogs. This study will compare the liver protective capacity of two veterinary liver protectant products in dogs suffering from xylitol toxicity.
L128: 
L129: 【35†Study Details】
L130:   * ### 【36†Oral Melanoma Study in Dogs】
L131: 
L132: Open
L133: 
L134: This clinical trial will evaluate the effectiveness of a novel investigational product for the treatment of oral melanoma in dogs.
L135: 【36†Study Details】
L136:   * ### 【37†Dysbiosis Enhancing Linkage Towards Association with Canine Osteosarcoma (DEL-TACO Lite)】
L137: 
L138: Open
L139: 
L140: This study aims to determine whether or not canine patients diagnosed with canine osteosarcoma (OSA) have intestinal dysbiosis and whether treating intestinal disease improves patient outcomes.
L141: 
L142: 【37†Study Details】
L143:   * ### 【38†Ethos Precision Medicine Umbrella Study for Hemangiosarcoma (Ethos-PUSH)】
L144: 
L145: Open
L146: Is your dog undergoing surgery for a ruptured splenic tumor? Ethos Discovery would love to have you and your dog participate in our clinical trial! We are evaluating drugs for the treatment of HSA with the goal of curing this aggressive cancer.
L147:

L116:   * ### 【34†SEPSIS Clinical Study】
L117: 
L118: Open
L119: This study aims to evaluate changes in a specific blood hormone that has previously been related to sepsis diagnosis in canine patients surgically treated for sepsis in the abdomen and in healthy dogs with intestinal obstructions that are being surgically removed. We are investigating possible novel markers for sepsis with the goal of developing new diagnostic tests.
